audit.why: Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin already matches the mirror at audits/top/kassadin__singed.json exactly — Singed owns levels 1-2 and the proxy window, the lane is a farm race at 3-5, and Kassadin owns everything from his ult onward. Nothing to flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike reference treats Riftwalk as something you 'track the cooldown' of. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds. It is never down.
audit.why: Riot cooldown for Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2, and multiple casts in a row are gated by escalating mana, not by cooldown. Telling a Singed to engage 'once Riftwalk is down' is advice that can never be executed. The genuinely punishable Kassadin cooldown in this lane is Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17 — it is his only slow and the only thing that keeps him attached to you.
audit.corrected: The spike that matters is Kassadin's level 6 plus his mana pool, not a Riftwalk cooldown; the window you commit into is the 17-21s Force Pulse gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction is absent from Singed's side and the page advises the opposite. mid says 'do not commit a Fling when he has it up, because he will simply blink out of range'. Riftwalk is a dash, and Mega Adhesive grounds — inside the puddle Riftwalk does not cast at all. The order is W first, then E, not 'don't commit'.
audit.why: Riot Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Riot Fling: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Kassadin's whole escape is one dash. The mirror page (kassadin__singed.json, point 4) reaches the identical conclusion from the other side and calls it the biggest fact in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive (17/16/15/14/13s) under his feet turns Riftwalk off; Fling (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range) landing him back in the puddle roots him. That is the combo, and it works at 6 and after.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] claims you run poison through him at levels 1-2 with 'zero counterplay'. Void Stone reduces the magic damage Poison Trail deals, and Null Sphere's shield eats the chip on top.
audit.why: Riot Void Stone: 'Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.' Poison Trail is magic damage. Riot Null Sphere: the excess energy 'forms around himself, granting a temporary shield'. So the early poison race is real but slower than the page promises, and unit-collision immunity also means you cannot body-block him against the wave.
audit.corrected: Early poison still wins the race because he has no answer to being chased, but the page should say the damage is taxed by Void Stone rather than free.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Null Sphere a 'Q silence' in three places.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere text is 'dealing damage and interrupting channels' plus a shield — no silence is described, and the kit's derived flags list projectile, shield and channel with no silence flag. The ability is also never named on the page.
audit.corrected: Name it Null Sphere and describe the effect Riot's text supports: it interrupts channels and shields him through your poison chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0] both nominate Riftwalk as the tracked cooldown.
audit.why: See point 3 — 2-5s is not a window. Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17 is.
audit.corrected: Force Pulse is the tracked cooldown; Mega Adhesive is the tracked ability of your own.

edits.before: Kassadin has no Riftwalk and his Q silence costs mana — run Poison Trail through him freely and establish the proxy pattern before he can respond.
edits.after: Kassadin has no Riftwalk yet and Null Sphere shields him — Void Stone taxes your magic damage, so poison him on every pass and build the proxy pattern instead.

edits.before: Use Mega Adhesive and Fling to punish any pre-6 all-in when he steps up to Q silence you
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive under him then Fling — grounded, he cannot Riftwalk, and landing roots him

edits.before: At levels 4-5, shift your attention off direct trades and onto the proxy game — Ghost into the enemy jungle side lane, farm his wave behind his tower, and force him to choose between losing CS and walking into your pattern without backup. Kassadin's only answer pre-6 is to freeze and wait, which you want: it means his jungler has to come top to stop the bleed, opening the map for your team. When you do come back to lane, keep the wave on your side of the river so he has to overextend into Poison Trail range to farm. At level 6, his Riftwalk changes everything — do not commit a Fling when he has it up, because he will simply blink out of range and reposition before the poison can stick long enough to matter.
edits.after: At levels 4-5, shift your attention off direct trades and onto the proxy game — Ghost into the enemy jungle side lane, farm his wave behind his tower, and force him to choose between losing CS and walking into your pattern without backup. Kassadin's only answer pre-6 is to freeze and wait, which you want: it means his jungler has to come top to stop the bleed, opening the map for your team. When you do come back to lane, keep the wave on your side of the river so he has to overextend into Poison Trail range to farm. At 6 Riftwalk is up every 2-5s, so never wait for it: Mega Adhesive grounds, and a grounded Kassadin cannot Riftwalk at all. Goo first, Fling second, and the landing roots him in it.

edits.before: Riftwalk online means he can chase your Ghost or exit any Fling commitment cleanly — trade only on cooldown with the wave firmly on your side.
edits.after: Riftwalk is up every 2-5s so there is no cooldown to wait for — lead with Mega Adhesive, grounded means the blink will not cast, then Fling him back in.

edits.before: Land Q silence to interrupt your run-through and cancel Ghost momentum before you establish the pattern
edits.after: Land Null Sphere to break your run-through and bank its shield against the poison before your pattern starts

edits.before: Bully him early — poison-kite him and fling the Riftwalk commit. Singed wins the Riftwalk cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully him early — goo him first: grounded, Riftwalk will not cast, and the Fling landing roots him in it.

edits.before: Poison-kite him and fling the Riftwalk commit. Track Riftwalk before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds Riftwalk off — goo, then Fling him back into it. Track Force Pulse, and keep the wave your side.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Force Pulse: 21/20/19/18/17s, his only slow — that gap is your window. Riftwalk at 2-5s is never trackable. - Mega Adhesive 17-13s: grounds the blink, so it opens every commit. - Insanity Potion 100s: kill windows only.
edits.note: Riftwalk cooldown 5/3.5/2 per Riot; Force Pulse is the real punishable one.
